absolute_locality.authority: post-hoc cohort-relative descriptive label; not a universal threshold
absolute_locality.exact_cacheable_threshold: median EXACT hit ratio in the frozen 24-prompt cohort
absolute_locality.high_s2_threshold: median S2_P50 hit ratio in the frozen 24-prompt cohort

interaction_strength.authority: post-hoc descriptive label; not a tuning gate
interaction_strength.statistic: population CV of prompt-level S2_P50-vs-KNEE TPS fractional gain

classification_rules.s2_vs_knee_material_gain: TPS ratio >= 1.02, hit-ratio delta >= 0.01, and loads/token delta < 0

interpretation_limits: The 24 prompts are a frozen explanatory sample, not a random sample of all prompts.
Generated-ID prefix/alignment/edit evidence is trajectory feedback only, not quality.
Observer/replay outputs are non-performance evidence; physical Stage-C cells own TPS.
No S2_P50, KNEE, capacity, corpus, order, or runtime parameter was retuned.

physical_replay_anchor_validation.authority: Stage-C physical EXACT validates the semantic-order replay at the frozen 7,849-slot anchor; larger-capacity replay remains offline evidence, not TPS.
